limitations.note: The rewrite removed the combinational counter feedback but replaced the intended three-phase sequence with disjoint pairs, dropping the output on every third valid input and its `{data_lock[3:0], data_in}` packing.

The passing test expected no output on the third accepted byte, where the intended circuit asserts `valid_out` and emits `12'h312`, so it validated the rewrite’s assumption instead of catching the regression.
